schema_basis: Original publication-tag sources, not an opened dataset

conditions.A: Paper and same admitted neutral neural inputs/calibration, schema documentation; official analysis and caches excluded
conditions.B: Identical data/resources plus historically qualified official code; grading targets/reference outputs excluded

construction_algorithms: strict owner trial census and midpoint/one-trial-guard split
complete six-class balanced improvement scorer against full and diagonal LDA
full five-animal within/cross-time numerical reproduction comparator
unimplemented_components: authenticated MAT-to-neutral index and neural tensors
trusted external owner artifact store and source pin binding
protected candidate execution/projection and five isolated outer folds
competent MATLAB reference fitting and parameter search
complete captured fold/repeat predictions and fit/resource ledger
admission_gaps: Actual archive/member/animal/session joins and member content hashes
Exact six absolute velocity values/class ordering and full trial exclusions
WheelSpeed sample support and units, stimulus/spike clock alignment
Strict >75% paper vs >=75% source state thresholds
Full-session original unit mask vs calibration-only extension mask
Implicit nTrials MAT/workspace dependency in full-population script
Original source draws one random half, not exhaustive complementary two-fold CV
Inner5fold source defaults, Bayesian acquisition per-second vs plus, search budget/RNG
Eq21 unclipped vs source below-chance-clipped relative score
MATLAB/toolbox licensing and runtime closure; source analysis fields/plot sections
Full five-animal reference and exact numerical tolerances
Owner-fixed chronological support and one-guard temporal window nonoverlap; no data-based cut moving
Public-outcome contamination; no SOTA or secret-test claim
field_projection_limits: Query function emits identity/window metadata only. It cannot claim neural feature projection or original input provenance.

protocol_refinements.state_reference: pooled-state matched LDA adaptations; no state-dependent dispatch
protocol_refinements.tuning: outer four animals freeze algorithm/policy; frozen policy fits parameters on held calibration only
protocol_refinements.query_order: sort random opaque IDs/window; entropy/lineage audit remains external
protocol_refinements.chronology: fixed midpoint and guard; enforce full source-window separation
